summary: Implemented the rich_measure for Tree and rich.align.VerticalCenter feature. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative stack walk, indent 4 per level, uses Measurement.get with the given max_width) and imports Measurement. rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, the VerticalCenter class (render with padding newlines from console.size.height, measure delegating to Measurement.get, repr), and an Align width constraint that uses the wrapped renderable's measured maximum (or the smaller of that and an explicit width). rich/console.py sets justify="default" in print's render options while still passing justify into _collect_renderables. CHANGELOG.md: 9.8.0 marked Unreleased with an Added section containing the two entries. Tests: tests/test_align.py imports VerticalCenter and adds repr, VerticalCenter render, tall-content, and measure tests; tests/test_tree.py imports Measurement and adds a tree measurement test expecting Measurement(11, 19). Nothing was committed. Tests were not run, per the instructions; all verification was by reading the code.
